works.title: Gold and Shadow
works.subtitle: A Complete History of the Lands Between, Compiled from the Relics and Remembrances
works.blurb: A book-length in-world history in the manner of Fire & Blood: an unnamed chronicler, working in the Roundtable Hold's library after the Erdtree burned, reconstructs the whole story from the game's actual evidence — and tells you, sentence by sentence, how sure he is. Flat statements are explicit in-game text; "the inscription would have us believe" marks rumor; "perhaps" means exactly perhaps.
works.spoilers: Full spoilers — base game, all endings, and the entire DLC.
